tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The ground: deep space in a run, the page behind every panel. Bridge is near-black with a teal bias; Drydock is a cool paper grey.

tokens.name: hull
tokens.usage: Panel glass: refit, hail, pause and summary panels, HUD chips.

tokens.name: hull-2
tokens.usage: Raised inside a panel: cards, tiles, the schematic viewport.

tokens.name: hull-3
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill on hull-2; the unlit tick of a meter on paper.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, chart grid, panel interiors. Never a control border (under 3:1).

tokens.name: rule-2
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: corner brackets at rest, unlit panel edges, card edges at rest.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: ghost buttons, key caps, inputs. At least 3:1 on void, hull and hull-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on void, hull and hull-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: benefit sentences, hints, axis labels, on void, hull and hull-2.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: caveats, annotation texture, unlit labels. Passes 4.5:1 on all three grounds; keep it at 9px or more.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Cyan: everything that is ours. The ship, its fire, the XP rail, lit panel edges, figures on cards. As text on void, hull and hull-2.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill.

tokens.name: signal-ghost
tokens.usage: Unlit ticks of a signal meter; the faint wash inside a selected HUD chip.

tokens.name: command
tokens.usage: Amber: the player's hand. Selection, focus, the primary action, key caps you can press now. As text on void, hull and hull-2.

tokens.name: command-fill
tokens.usage: Amber as a fill: the primary button, a filled key cap, the cover block. Always with on-command text.

tokens.name: on-command
tokens.usage: Text on command-fill, both themes.

tokens.name: dilithium
tokens.usage: Violet: the field. Asteroid edges, dilithium crystals, the XP gem icon, the Ship upgrade category. As text on void, hull and hull-2.

tokens.name: on-dilithium
tokens.usage: Text on a dilithium fill.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Yellow alert: a capital ship inbound, hazard placards. Only ever a fill, with on-caution text; never text on its own.

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text and stripes on caution.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Red alert: hull damage, one plate left, hull breach, the hail. As text on void, hull and hull-2.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text on an alert fill.

tokens.name: nominal
tokens.usage: A gain against last run (▲ +23) and a ready state. Always with a sign or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: faction-klingon
tokens.usage: Klingon hulls, fire and capital-ship name. Text on void, hull and hull-2.

tokens.name: faction-cardassian
tokens.usage: Cardassian hulls, fire and capital-ship name.

tokens.name: faction-romulan
tokens.usage: Romulan hulls, plasma and capital-ship name.

tokens.name: faction-borg
tokens.usage: Borg hull plating and name. Its cutting beam and emissives use nominal green.

tokens.name: faction-tholian
tokens.usage: Tholian hulls and shards. Their webs use dilithium violet.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px gap. 8.7:1 or better on Bridge grounds, 4.5:1 or better on Drydock.

families.rail: Antonio, "Swiss 911 Ultra Compressed", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Tektur. The voice: screen titles, card names and the sentences the player reads.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen: the title of a full-screen panel. Caps.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Panel titles set hard right in the elbow's rail. Caps.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Adds torpedoes that chase their target.
styles.usage: Benefit sentences and anything read as a sentence. Sentence case.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: They fire and reload on their own.
styles.usage: Caveats under a benefit, in ink-3.

groups.name: Rail
groups.note: Antonio, the free cut closest to LCARS's ultra-compressed grotesk. Structure and numerals.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: The one figure a screen exists for: the final stardate.

styles.name: rail-label
styles.usage: Labels on the elbow's bar and rail, navigation, the refit number. Caps.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Martian Mono. Instruments: figures, key caps, codes and the annotation texture.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Figures on cards, in signal. Sentence case, numbers as figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Micro labels over values, category words, key caps. Caps.

styles.name: annotation
styles.usage: Texture that is still true: coordinates, velocity, registry codes. ink-3, caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; tick gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and key caps; between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on phones; between HUD groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; the viewscreen inset for corner brackets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gutters between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; the HUD's safe margin.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between screen regions on the title and summary screens.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. The system cuts corners, it does not round them.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status dots, the thumbstick ring and knob. Nothing else is round.

cut.note: Chamfer sizes: the 45-degree corner every frame, button, chip and plate is cut with.

tokens.name: cut-xs
tokens.usage: Hull plates, status chips, key caps.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, HUD chips.

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, the schematic viewport.

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the outer corner of the elbow.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules, card edges, chart grid.

tokens.name: stroke-bracket
tokens.usage: Corner brackets, icon strokes at 16px.

tokens.name: stroke-rail
tokens.usage: The elbow's rail.

tokens.name: stroke-bar
tokens.usage: The elbow's bar.

shadow.note: Glow is a state, not a finish: it appears on what is live, selected or ready, and Drydock has none.

tokens.name: glow-signal
tokens.usage: A lit signal edge: the selected HUD chip, a ready meter.

tokens.name: glow-command
tokens.usage: The selected card, the primary button on hover.

tokens.name: glow-alert
tokens.usage: Hull breach and red-alert panels.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: A panel over the field; the selected card's 3px lift.
